.gmd-project-feature__title.font: 400 clamp(1.75rem, 3vw, 2.75rem)/1.12 var(--gmd-font-display, PerfectlyNineties, 'Source Serif 4 Variable', serif)

.gmd-pattern-cover__content h2.font: 400 clamp(1.65rem, 3vw, 2.4rem)/1.12 var(--gmd-font-display, PerfectlyNineties, 'Source Serif 4 Variable', serif)

.gmd-empty-state__body h2.font: 400 clamp(1.4rem, 2.3vw, 2rem)/1.2 var(--gmd-font-display, PerfectlyNineties, 'Source Serif 4 Variable', serif)

[data-slot=skeleton].background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--muted), color-mix(in srgb, var(--gmd-nile-soft) 55%, var(--muted)), var(--muted))

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast (Sonner)
items.description: Current toast implementation is Sonner; this alias avoids installing a second toast stack.

items.name: theme-film
items.title: GMD film theme
items.description: Use data-gmd-theme="film" on document.documentElement. Own the installed CSS to remix project roles.

items.name: theme-archive
items.title: GMD archive theme
items.description: Use data-gmd-theme="archive" on document.documentElement. Own the installed CSS to remix project roles.

items.name: gmd-all
items.title: GMD complete component system
items.description: Full adapted shadcn catalog, GMD visual compositions, foundations and project themes. React 19, Tailwind 4.
